title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs Security Update
description: Red Hat has issued a security update for Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs addressing a critical vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-114938 in the java-21-openjdk-portable package. The update includes multiple RPMs for various architectures such as aarch64, s390x, and x86_64. The advisory does not provide detailed technical information about the vulnerability but classifies it as critical and associates it with CWE-787 (Out-of-bounds Write).
